details:
Q1. Which repo surface should be improved?
Choices:
A. A workflow under `.github/workflows/` — name which one (`clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review`, `orchestrate`, `validate`, etc.) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Shared helpers under `scripts/`
C. Docs / templates / setup guidance
D. Other — give the exact path(s), file(s), or user flow
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken behavior or regression — include current behavior vs expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability / reduce flakes or failures
C. Improve output quality / prompt / comment / report quality
D. Improve maintainability / cleanup without changing behavior
E. Improve speed / cost / rate-limit efficiency
Q3. What concrete reference should implementation use?
Choices:
A. A specific issue, PR, or workflow run number/link showing the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific file path or function/symbol name
C. A before/after example of the desired behavior or output
D. Step-by-step reproduction of the problem
